evidence.note: ConPress observes that a reasoning model shortens its traces when several independent questions share one prompt, and harvests those shortened traces as self-supervised fine-tuning data for the single-question setting.
evidence.title: ConPress: Learning Efficient Reasoning from Multi-Question Contextual Pressure

evidence.note: Trains large reasoning models with self-distillation followed by diversity-aware RL to overcome 'Lazy Reasoning' -- inadequate task decomposition -- in complex tool-use settings.
evidence.title: D-CORE: Incentivizing Task Decomposition in Large Reasoning Models for Complex Tool Use
